source: Pew Research Center. "Faith Among Black Americans," published Feb. 16, 2021 (survey fielded Nov. 19, 2019-June 3, 2020).
method: Population is Black American adults ("black faith black respondents.sav"), grouped by self-reported present religion (RELIGMOD): named affiliations shown individually; Atheist, Agnostic, and Nothing in particular combined into "Religiously unaffiliated." Share answering "Yes" to SERV1 ("Have you ever turned to a church or other religious congregation for help with bills, housing or food?"); not-answered excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT variable.
